$comment: Provided schema of a file's meta head, validated against the sample beside it (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): the keys of catzc.immutable and catzc.edges, which a tool may rely on. The head of an authored file holds a warning naming the command that writes it (catzc.warning) and its edges, its comment page (docs) and the ADR codes its prose cites (cites), with the count of every distinct code the document cites, its yml drawio blocks included (drs_total), and a file with neither edge carries no head. A generated file's head holds warning, and with_body_sha while git tracks the file. Every other fact about a file is derived on demand. A fact a file has no value for is left out, so no key is required.
